source.title: Harmony4D test/03_grappling2.zip, sequence 032_grappling2
source.author: Rawal Khirodkar, Jyun-Ting Song, Jinkun Cao, Zhengyi Luo, Kris Kitani (Carnegie Mellon University), Harmony4D, NeurIPS 2024
source.notes: Multi-view triangulated COCO-17 3D keypoints (processed_data/poses3d), 20 fps, both people. Floor fitted to ankles; hands are wrists, neck is mid-shoulders and head is mid-ears. Toes are not tracked and are inferred one foot-length ahead of each ankle along pelvis facing. Source camera cam01 sampled at pose indices 7, 16, 26, 36, 46 and 53. The images show a continuous close-contact wrestling exchange transitioning down to a kneeling position; several hands and parts of the bodies are occluded by overlap. This is a camera context check, not a verified technique label. No palm/sole contact labels are supplied or inferred. Converted from the released pose arrays with tools/motion/harmony4d/harmony_take.py conventions.
